from datetime import datetime
import pytz
from dateutil.parser import parse

def task_func(date_str, tz_str):
    dt = parse(date_str)
    tz = pytz.timezone(tz_str)

    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        current_dt = tz.localize(dt)
    else:
        current_dt = dt.astimezone(tz)

    next_year = current_dt.year + 1
    target_dt = tz.localize(datetime(next_year, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))

    return int((target_dt - current_dt).total_seconds())
